newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul stocks fall on inflation worries.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul stocks fall on inflation worries.

text.p: Istanbul stock fell sharply in early trade on Wednesday on pessimism over inflation rates, fuelled by remarks of a key cabinet member.
The IMKB National-100 was down by 37 points or 1.89 percent at 1,916 at 0735 GMT.
Turkey's new economy minister Gunes Taner said late on Tuesday he expected year end inflation to be around 100 percent.
The announcement led to rises in bonds and treasury bills as investors transferred money to these markets and away from the stock exchange, brokers said.
